external_collaboration.evidence_quote: All of our courses are offered through Jacksonville University (Florida) that serves as our official school of records. Non-JU students will receive a transcript to transfer course credits to their home institution.

Sant’Anna Institute has partnered with Napoli Women to develop new international study abroad opportunities connecting academics, professional soccer, and cultural immersion in Southern Italy.Through the partnership, students will combine academic coursework at Sant’Anna with experiences developed alongside Napoli Women, including opportunities related to training, sport management, performance psychology, video analysis, sports nutrition, and the operations of a professional Serie A Women club.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Sant’Anna Institute is an international community of constant cultural exchange between faculty, staff, and students. It is located in Sorrento in southern Italy. Our school is an impressive historic structure perched on the cliffs of the Amalfi Coast, overlooking the fishing village of Marina Grande and is a short walk from the city center.
